idea-plugin.name: MASMLD RISC-V
idea-plugin.description:
RISC-V GNU assembly support for MASMLD, with RustRover as the primary tested product.

  • Syntax highlighting for instructions, pseudo instructions, registers, directives, labels, comments and strings.
  • Offline Chinese quick documentation for 465 instruction, register and directive names.
  • Navigate to labels, numeric local labels, constants, exported assembly symbols and include-aware .macro definitions.
  • External source symbols use the host IDE indexes, including Rust and C/C++ when available.

Requires MASMLD Core. Select RISC-V under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → MASMLD Assembly. Enable quick documentation on hover in editor settings. Includes completion, parameter information, basic ISA diagnostics, find usages, rename, structure, folding and formatting. External demangling and linked debug-source lookup are optional configured tools. No assembler, debugger or complete macro expansion is provided.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.8 development: contextual completion and parameter hints; include-aware symbols; ISA configuration and diagnostics; find usages and rename; structure, folding and formatting; GNU ld expressions and layout hints; optional binary symbol/debug-source navigation. See the repository changelog for coverage and limitations.
